title: How high is the world? Mountains, plateaus and height above sea level on one map
excerpt: A map of the height of the whole planet, sharp from continents to valleys. The world's land averages 807 m, only 11% of it is above 2,000 m, and only 1.9% of the people in its cities live that high.
seo_description: An interactive world map of height above sea level, with shaded relief, peaks and cities, and how much of the land is high.
header_alt: Title card reading 'How high is the world?' in black on cream, with the line: only 11% of the land is above 2,000 m, 1.9% of city people live that high. Beside it a world relief map in the Equal Earth projection, green lowlands rising through tan and brown to the pale mauve of the Tibetan Plateau and the Andes, with Greenland's ice dome in brown.
